Elderly couple dies in mud wall collapse during heavy rain

An elderly couple, identified as Tenga and Mahi Kispata, died in Rourkela after a mud wall of their house collapsed during heavy rainfall. Police have registered a case of unnatural death. The incident occurred in the Sundargarh district.
